answer: Harberger-taxed identity slots deter a sybil farm. Each agent seat is a marble dropped into a public vault at a price you set yourself, and every epoch you pay a recurring holding tax on that self-assessment while anyone may force-buy the slot at your stated price. Hold one honest identity and the carrying cost stays flat; spin up N clones and you owe that tax N times over, continuously, so the delta between a single agent and a fake army widens each epoch. Underprice to dodge the tax and a rival simply buys the marble out from under you.
